description: lockstep hook wrappers (Stop / SessionStart / PreToolUse / PostToolUse) — run the plugin's own cloned engine through its shared launcher, no PyPI dependency. Timeouts are generous ON PURPOSE: a hook killed at its budget emits no output, and a timed-out PreToolUse hook is treated as non-blocking — the gate would fail OPEN. The first fire in a cold environment resolves and builds the engine's dependencies; run `lockstep-mcp doctor` once after install to pay that cost outside the gate.
